NAME

platform_directory_candidate_t - Ordered list of platform-specific application directories.

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/platform/filesystem.h>

Data Fields


char * path
int mode

Detailed Description

Ordered list of platform-specific application directories.

Each path is freshly allocated and includes a trailing path separator. The entries are ordered from most to least preferred.
